title: College Fee Structure and Tuition Charges
content: The annual fee structure approved by the State Fee Regulating Authority includes Tuition Fee of Rs 1,15,000, Development Fee of Rs 15,000, and College Caution Money Deposit of Rs 5,000 (refundable). Fees can be paid online via Net Banking, UPI, Demand Draft, or Debit/Credit card through the student ERP fee payment portal.
